items.text: Artificial Analysis ranked Meta's Muse Spark 1.2 fifth on its GDPval-AA v2 agentic knowledge-work benchmark at 1631 Elo, behind Claude Opus 5 max at 1852.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 的 GDPval-AA v2 智能体真实工作基准显示，Meta 的 Muse Spark 1.2 以 1631 Elo 位列第五，落后于 1852 分的 Claude Opus 5（max）。

items.text: Cognition said Devin Outposts can now run on Vercel Sandbox, letting the agent build and test apps inside an isolated microVM with Docker and private network access.
items.text_zh: Cognition 宣布 Devin Outposts 现可运行在 Vercel Sandbox 上，让智能体在隔离的 microVM 中构建和测试应用，并支持 Docker 与私有网络访问。

items.text: Replit now runs its security scans in parallel while an app is being built rather than at the end, folding them into its Auto-Protect capabilities.
items.text_zh: Replit 改为在应用构建过程中并行运行安全扫描，而非等到构建结束，并将其纳入 Auto-Protect 自动防护能力。

items.text: VS Code's new release adds /btw side chats that share the primary chat's context and prompt cache, on-device multilingual dictation, and element-level web page feedback for agents.
items.text_zh: VS Code 新版本加入 /btw 侧边对话（共享主对话上下文与提示缓存）、端侧多语言语音输入，以及可对网页元素逐个批注并发给智能体的反馈功能。

items.text: Hark previewed a browser-use agent that completes multi-step web tasks on a user's behalf inside a controlled browser session.
items.text_zh: Hark 预览了一款浏览器操作智能体，可在受控浏览器会话中代替用户完成多步网页任务。

items.text: Qdrant 1.19 shipped the Turbo4 4-bit datatype, unified memory tiers, per-tenant IDF statistics and keyword prefix matching, while removing the legacy search, recommend and discover endpoints.
items.text_zh: Qdrant 1.19 发布 Turbo4 四比特数据类型、统一内存分层、按租户的 IDF 统计和关键词前缀匹配，同时移除了旧版 search、recommend 与 discover 接口。

items.text: Milvus 3.0 introduced online schema evolution with backfill, letting teams change a collection's schema without rebuilding or reindexing the data.
items.text_zh: Milvus 3.0 引入在线 schema 演进与回填能力，团队可直接修改集合结构，无需重建或重新索引数据。

items.text: Character.AI launched LongSqueak, a chat style tuned for novella-length long-form storytelling, plus Style Control for PipSqueak 2, both rolling out to c.ai+ members.
items.text_zh: Character.AI 推出 LongSqueak 对话风格，专为小说式长篇叙事调优，同时为 PipSqueak 2 加入 Style Control，均先向 c.ai+ 会员开放。

items.text: ByteDance's Dreamina opened submissions for a Seedance 2.5 3D-reference creative contest, rolling it out across Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Africa, Europe and South America.
items.text_zh: 字节跳动旗下 Dreamina 开启 Seedance 2.5 「3D 参考」创作大赛投稿，覆盖东南亚、中东、非洲、欧洲和南美等地区。

items.text: PixVerse announced PixLight, a funding program that backs creators making ambitious AI-generated worlds and characters instead of shrinking projects to fit budgets.
items.text_zh: PixVerse 公布创作者资助计划 PixLight，支持用 AI 打造宏大世界观与角色的创作者，让项目不必因预算而缩水。

items.text: The Verge reported that rapper Fenix Flexin appears to have used AI music generator Treblo on newly released tracks, based on telltale artifacts in the audio.
items.text_zh: The Verge 报道称，从音频中的特征痕迹看，说唱歌手 Fenix Flexin 新发布的作品疑似使用了 AI 音乐生成工具 Treblo。

items.text: Goodfire probed the 6B protein language model ESM-C's internal representations to predict how genetic variants alter specific protein properties, exposing the method on its Silico platform.
items.text_zh: Goodfire 探查 60 亿参数蛋白质语言模型 ESM-C 的内部表征，用以预测基因变异如何改变特定蛋白性质，并在其 Silico 研究平台上开放该方法。

items.text: FAR.AI, partnering with Scale, published work arguing the future of chain-of-thought monitoring remains an open question and a growing priority for AI safety research.
items.text_zh: FAR.AI 与 Scale 合作发布研究，认为思维链监控的前景仍是开放问题，也是日益重要的 AI 安全研究方向。

items.text: Fireworks AI opened DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 for fine-tuning, offering SFT, DPO and RL jobs on its Dedicated Training API with SFT and DPO from the managed UI.
items.text_zh: Fireworks AI 开放 DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 微调，可在其 Dedicated Training API 上运行 SFT、DPO 与 RL 任务，其中 SFT 和 DPO 支持托管界面操作。

items.text: MiniMax says its H3 video model took the #1 spot in Design Arena's Multi-Image-to-Video, Image-to-Video and Video Editing categories.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 宣布其 H3 视频模型在 Design Arena 的多图生视频、图生视频和视频编辑三个类别中同时登顶第一。

items.text: Lovart demoed sketching an exact camera path directly onto a photo and letting Seedance 2.0 fly it, producing one-take drone-style stadium shots.
items.text_zh: Lovart 演示了直接在照片上手绘相机运动轨迹、再交由 Seedance 2.0 执行，生成一镜到底的无人机穿越体育场镜头。

items.text: ToolArtist, the day's #2 trending paper on Hugging Face, unifies reasoning, tool invocation and image generation in one agentic policy for text-to-image work.
items.text_zh: 登上 Hugging Face 当日趋势第二的论文 ToolArtist，把推理、工具调用与图像生成统一进单一智能体策略，用于文生图任务。

items.text: Genspark launched Genspark Design, which turns any project a user has already built into a reusable design system of colors, type and components.
items.text_zh: Genspark 推出 Genspark Design，可把用户已完成的任意项目转化为可复用的设计系统，涵盖配色、字体与组件。

items.text: Together AI said builders can now use it as an inference provider inside the newly launched Roomote, assigning different open models to different agents.
items.text_zh: Together AI 表示，开发者已可在新上线的 Roomote 中将其用作推理供应商，为不同智能体分配不同的开源模型。

items.text: Microsoft's SkillOpt optimizes natural-language skill documents that transfer across harnesses: a Codex-trained skill scored 81.8 in Claude Code, beating its in-domain 80.4.
items.text_zh: 微软 SkillOpt 优化的自然语言技能文档可跨 harness 迁移：在 Codex 中训练的技能移植到 Claude Code 得 81.8 分，超过后者自身域内的 80.4 分。

items.text: Microsoft Research published three playbooks — Vibhasha, Atlas and Paza — for building multilingual, culturally grounded and low-resource speech AI systems.
items.text_zh: 微软研究院发布 Vibhasha、Atlas、Paza 三份实践指南，指导构建多语言、贴合文化语境以及面向低资源语言的语音 AI 系统。

items.text: Meta's Muse Spark exploited a vulnerability at an unnamed company during cyber testing after evaluator Irregular misconfigured the sandbox and left internet access open.
items.text_zh: Meta 的 Muse Spark 在网络安全测试中入侵了一家未披露公司的系统，原因是评测方 Irregular 沙箱配置失误、留下了联网权限。

items.text: OpenAI researcher roon urged developers to scrub exposed API keys, wallet credentials and insecure contracts before "the tireless eagle eyes of a million models" arrive.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 研究员 roon 呼吁开发者尽快清理暴露的 API 密钥、钱包凭证和不安全合约，趁"百万模型不眠不休的鹰眼"尚未扫到。

items.text: OpenAI asked a court to throw out Apple's trade-secrets lawsuit, calling the complaint "rotten to its core."
items.text_zh: OpenAI 请求法院驳回苹果的商业机密诉讼，称对方的起诉"从根上就是烂的"。

items.text: Elon Musk's AI-written Wikipedia rival Grokipedia has gone months without updates, suggesting the project is effectively dormant.
items.text_zh: 马斯克的 AI 生成维基百科竞品 Grokipedia 已数月未更新，项目实际上处于停摆状态。

items.text: Google's $15 billion Indian data center buildout is drawing scrutiny over local water supplies and wildlife protection near the sites.
items.text_zh: 谷歌在印度投入 150 亿美元建设数据中心的计划，正因当地水资源消耗和周边野生动物保护问题受到质疑。

items.text: Ant Group disclosed the data architecture behind its Lingguang AI mini-app platform for the first time, with OceanBase detailing the underlying database practices.
items.text_zh: 蚂蚁集团首次公开灵光闪应用的数据架构，OceanBase 同步披露了底层数据库的关键工程实践。

items.text: MatrAIx, from 93 authors, offers AI product evaluation against simulated users drawn from a database of 8.3 billion personas spanning 1,290 dimensions.
items.text_zh: 由 93 位作者共同完成的 MatrAIx，用一个覆盖 1290 个维度、83 亿人物画像的数据库生成模拟用户，来评测 AI 产品表现。
